body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-014-v2-wallet-pantry-multistore.md (v2, builds on SC-001). Do not edit either spec. Do not call Gemini or any live API in tests. Do not commit secrets, personal data, or the e-bill PDFs. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000.

Replace the v1 guest page at / with the v2 guided flow, server-rendered with one stylesheet at /static/app.css, no frontend framework, no login. Steps: Pantry (due and soon items from the pantry engine with reasons and checkboxes), Wallet (cards as issuer and product, no numbers), Plan (store bills with items, chosen card, savings bar, both baselines, the day sweep, editable trip cost and max stores), Why (agent explanation and every tool call with its arguments), Approve (MOCK and the sentence No order is sent.). Use sample receipt and Extract this image stay available and add receipt lines to the pantry inputs. The sample-data banner is on every step. Mobile-first, viewport meta, one h1, a main landmark, a label for every input and select, visible focus, never color alone.
The ADK agent gains get_pantry and plan_day tools and may re-plan. The Why step says plainly when the agent re-planned and with which arguments, and filters the agent's text against numbers in the engine plan plus every tool result from that agent run.
Retire tests/test_guest_page.py and tests/test_agent_page.py; re-assert in tests/test_v2_page.py the guarantees still in force: 503 without a model, explanation number filter, injection text never reaches the agent, agent failures are logged and fall back to the engine explanation.
README.md describes the v2 judge path; python scripts/check_judge_readme.py still passes.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The guided flow is accessible. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v2_page.py::test_guided_flow_is_accessible -q
2. The Plan step shows store bills and savings. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v2_page.py::test_plan_step_shows_store_bills_and_savings -q
3. Agent re-plans are disclosed and numbers grounded. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v2_page.py::test_agent_replan_is_disclosed_and_numbers_are_grounded -q
4. Every remaining test passes. Verify: python -m pytest -q
5. README checker passes. Verify: python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
title: Guided v2 guest flow with a re-planning ADK agent
